# LakeForge: scale benchmark

Produce data with `lakeforge benchmark --months 1 3`. Claims are limited to scaling trends on local hardware.

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

LAKE_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("LAKE_ROOT", "./data/lake")).resolve()
results = json.loads((LAKE_ROOT / "meta" / "benchmark.json").read_text())
df = pd.DataFrame(results)
df[["months", "silver_trips", "total_seconds", "rows_per_second", "gold_query_latency_ms"]]
stages = pd.DataFrame([r["stage_seconds"] for r in results], index=df["months"])
stages.plot.bar(stacked=True, figsize=(8, 4), title="Seconds per stage by data scale (months)")
df.plot(x="silver_trips", y="total_seconds", marker="o", title="Runtime vs rows")
